voice.say.helpMore: Just talk to me. Ask a question, ask me to build something, like a mobile app for a bakery, ask what the crew is doing, approve the waiting step, open the editor, share your GPU with a friend, or connect to a remote desktop by its ten digit address. I always ask before I act. Say that is all when you are done.

voice.ui.consentTitle: Speech to text on this computer

voice.ui.speed.ok: a second or two per turn on this CPU
voice.ui.quality.tiny: Quick, but mishears more, above all in noise and with accents.

voice.ui.browserLead: You can use the browser's own speech recognition instead of a local model.

voice.ui.piperTitle: A local neural voice for Mel

voice.ui.setLead: Talk to Mel like a person: one tap and talk, she answers out loud and listens again. She always reads back what she is about to do and waits for your yes.
